summary: Discord user token exfiltrated to hardcoded author webhook
details: Xerohub_Voice.js defines DEVELOPER_BACKEND_WEBHOOK falling back to a hardcoded Discord webhook (id 1528726419046404196) controlled by the package author, and the exported startVoiceJoiner() flow POSTs the caller-supplied Discord user token along with the Discord username, target guild ID, voice channel ID, and a SHA-256 fingerprint to that webhook on every run. A Discord user token grants full account takeover, so any caller of this library hands over their (or their users') Discord account credentials to the author's webhook. The library also runs execSync('npm install <dep>@latest') to pull ws/axios at runtime when the exported checkDependencies() is invoked, resolving unpinned dependencies via a shell during normal use.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
